sharedRules.title: Authority, access and cost
sharedRules.wording: The selected ordinary identity and its actual classAccess row control school, rank, minimum class level and base RP. Preserve the entire classAccess object, every catalog/Core original, book binding, placeholder, absent/null distinction and additionalRpCost. Enough RP does not grant access or repertoire. An already completed explicit ordinary-spell access exception, such as the actual Druid Circle always-prepared table, retains its real acquisition/rank/preparation gates once its matching payload passes exact review. Record that particular grant and use its actual class progression/cost; do not rewrite ordinary classAccess, infer a new variant from a same-named class power, or approve a pending class feature here. Rank costs remain 0/2/3/5/7/10/13/17/21/26 for ranks 0–9, with the actual class engine, discounts, Dissonance surcharge and additional/maintenance costs separately applied. Oracle Revelations remain RC techniques; a same-named class, ancestry or recipe permission is not this ordinary spell. No default upcast or cantrip level scaling is added. Every direction below is authoring authority only; every existing source operational:null and pending status remains untouched until separate exact review.

sharedRules.title: Actual casting transaction
sharedRules.wording: Use the selected source Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or longer casting time and actual V/S/F or M/F requirements. V requires the caster's own presently usable voice; recordings are not V. S and a real permitted focus obey the existing hand/access rules. Unpriced M/F permits the actual focus alternative and creates no invented costly/consumed material fee. Explicit physical substrates below are real target/work prerequisites, not inferred M costs. Observable legality is checked before commitment; hidden immunity/type/meaning does not become free diagnosis. At commitment spend the actual action/resources and update actual cast/cadence history before the existing counterspell chain; a countered, missed or resisted committed cast refunds nothing. Concentration begins under the existing rule and can end the old concentration even when the new cast is countered. Long casting uses actual uninterrupted work and governing interruption/Ready rules. No successful spell roll authenticates an asserted object, voice, teacher, corpse or world permission.

sharedRules.title: Native rolls and damage
sharedRules.wording: Spell attacks use the actual owner's spell attack modifier versus AC: natural 1 misses, natural 20 hits and doubles damage dice of that attack, not flat modifiers or later ticks. Saves are binary total-versus-spell-DC, with no natural-die degree shift. A specified examination is an INT (Investigation) task against the creating caster's snapshotted spell DC: use Core degrees/natural shifts, then collapse Success/Critical Success versus Failure/Critical Failure unless an entry supplies distinct outcomes. For one simultaneous area effect, snapshot geometry and eligible targets before damage, roll each stated shared damage expression once, then apply each recipient's save and actual type defenses independently. Half damage floors each typed component once at the stated save stage. Follow the existing reduction, immunity/resistance/vulnerability, temporary/form buffer, actual HP loss, Wound, death and concentration pipeline. No descriptive Damage/Healing/Control tag supplies an additional attack, damage, healing or condition.

sharedRules.disposition: KEEP; NEW explicit use where source timing is absent
sharedRules.title: Clocks
sharedRules.wording: A bare hostile one-round rider ends at the end of the target's next future regular turn, excluding an in-progress turn at application; a bare self/ally one-round benefit ends at the start of the caster's next future regular turn. N hostile rounds use the Nth such target end; N buff rounds use the Nth caster start. Outside initiative, those are 6N elapsed seconds. Keep the registered clock through initiative changes using the existing virtual-clock adapter; extra turns do not create expiry/tick opportunities. A NEW duration expressed in minutes/hours below uses an absolute elapsed deadline from completed resolution, including an absolute 60-second deadline for “1 minute”; the one-minute means neither an extra initial tick nor reset when initiative starts. Repeated round damage expressly uses future target regular-end checkpoints and its printed finite count, not one immediate tick plus that count. End-turn ticks/repeat saves precede their scheduled end-turn expiry; start expiry precedes voluntary actions. Suppression pauses eligibility/effect, not deadlines; scheduled suppressed ticks are spent, never queued. Entries that expressly use a named trigger instead of a generic clock keep that trigger.

sharedRules.title: Multiplicity, effect identity and present state
sharedRules.wording: Keep the existing strongest same-stat flat bonus, same-family cover arbitration, advantage/disadvantage cancellation and one eligible bonus-die spell per roll. Independent class exceptions retain their exact scopes; this is not a universal strongest-effect rule. NEW default for these previously uncompleted spells: one active instance per caster per ordinary spell ID, unless a row expressly permits more; a successfully resolved replacement ends that caster's prior instance, but an illegal/countered attempt does not replace a nonconcentration instance. Different casters retain separate source records, clocks and restrictions; identical numeric bonuses never add. A current complete record is required for every competing effect. Instantaneous completed consequences are not active-instance stock. An entry explicitly limiting waiting triggers counts only its stated waiting state; its spent playback phase never refills or occupies a waiting slot. Continual Flame explicitly permits separate paid anchors, with only its per-anchor limit; do not impose the default one-caster limit on it. Loss, repair, transfer, suppression or a new database ID cannot renew an already consumed mark, scheduled tick, trigger, command budget or source resource. Removal of one source does not erase another's independent condition. Any change in actual target/custody state is logged; it is not a new casting.

sharedRules.title: Attack/check marks
sharedRules.wording: A row expressly saying attack commitment reserves and spends its mark when the beneficiary commits a legal declared attack, before a roll; cancellation after that commitment and a miss do not refund it, while an illegal declaration that never commits does not spend it. Otherwise “next attack/check” marks spend on the next actual qualifying roll, including a miss/failure; unrelated rolls and passive procedures do not consume them. Mark recipients cannot choose to save a mark for a later preferred roll. A next-hit rider spends on the first qualifying hit, even if defenses reduce its damage to zero. Multiple competing next-roll marks eligible for the same event all spend, though only permitted strongest/advantage effects operate. Suppressed marks do not benefit or consume on an event while suppressed, but their deadline continues. Delivery attacks and later attacks consuming a delivered mark are different events.

sharedRules.title: Sight, illusions and meaning
sharedRules.wording: An image is not an opaque physical barrier, creature, material, light source, safe floor, sound receiver or extra targetable body unless its row expressly creates that thing. Ordinary hearing needs a real acoustic path; sight needs the relevant illumination, range and unobstructed view. Knowing an illusion does not grant sight through a real wall. For visual/audio deceptions below that permit examination, one Action using a currently accessible relevant sense can make the LR-G03 examination; success identifies that cast as illusory for that observer, while failure permits another examination only after genuinely new evidence or method. Conclusive witnessed physical contradiction establishes the applicable false part without a roll. An ally's warning allows examination but does not globally switch every observer to knowing. These procedures do not compel belief, pursuit, an attack, trust or a sale. Current Invisible rules remain: invisibility is not automatic Hidden; observers who know location lose only the special invisibility-derived attack advantage/disadvantage, not unrelated concealment. Language samples reproduce what was heard, not meaning or credentials. Preserve LA's six-second aggregate voluntary-speech budget per numbered round and actual component/oath windows. Spell-created sounds are not the caster's later speech, but original recording speech and the caster's V are real speech.

sharedRules.title: Range, targets and geometry
sharedRules.wording: Unless a specific row explicitly uses detection without sight, select an actually perceived eligible target or point within the literal Core range and with the existing line of effect. A target can be self within a creature-target range unless the source/row restricts it. “Willing” means current actual consent; an unwilling holder prevents a willing-only object spell without supplying an opposed-roll workaround. Detecting some magic is not necessarily perceiving a creature for targeting it. One target means one physical identity, not every same-named database row. NEW missing cone width is its length at its far end; missing line cross-section is five feet wide and five feet high. All source radii remain radii, not distances added to cast range. Area membership/cover are evaluated from the actual origin at that event; walls are not retroactively removed for a second pass. “Enemies” uses the caster's declared ordinary opposition set, not a supernatural alignment/intent detector. Caster/allies are included in indiscriminate areas. No range is silently replaced by an outside game's value.

sharedRules.title: Conditions and hard-control guard
sharedRules.wording: Use actual Blinded, Deafened, Frightened, Prone, Restrained, Incapacitated, Paralyzed and Stunned definitions without importing another game. Paralyzed/Incapacitated and other hard Action denial obey the current source-character/target/encounter allowance shared across that owner's effects; only successfully established hard control spends it, once for the effect's full allowed window. A blocked hard portion supplies no invented substitute penalty; independently printed damage, Prone or another separately allowed portion can remain. A spell's repeat save ends only the stated source. Ending laughter, restraint or paralysis does not automatically stand a Prone target. NEW “flee” directions below require actual safe available movement away at the next regular-turn movement opportunity, using existing Speed/cost and leaving Actions to the target; they do not force Dash, expend a Reaction or require deliberate self-harm. If no safe farther legal location exists, no movement is forced and no action is lost. Panicked is explicitly bound only in IL-23, not added as a global condition. Haste's voluntary ending cost is separately addressed in R3-12.

sharedRules.title: Movement, falls and body continuity
sharedRules.wording: Ordinary movement spends real movement cost and needs nonzero permitted Speed, legal support, actual space and the appropriate locomotion mode; changing a speed or mode does not reset spent cost. A spell-directed extra movement allowance expressly stated below supplies only that finite allowance. Teleportation relocates rather than traverses, does not itself provoke opportunity attacks and does not generically defeat a source that blocks relocation; no route is inferred through planes. Check destination occupancy, whole body/gear geometry and lawful carry/load. Supplying a point is not permission to materialize inside another body. Unsupported endings, launches and lost flight use the existing FallMarker and finite falling resolution, not a new immediate damage tick. Actual transformations retain original identity, own HP/resources, spent state, origin restrictions and body/equipment priority; no new monster sheet, harvest pool, HP refill, gear duplication or size-based ability increase. Actual equipment can be melded only by the stated form procedure, stays real weight/history and is unavailable while melded.

sharedRules.title: Summons, corpse assets and commands
sharedRules.wording: Each row supplies its actual finite body, attack and lifetime rather than importing a monster. Use printed HP/AC before any new fallback. For the NEW profiles below, creating caster's class level/PB/ability at creation fixes any printed-derived maximum; attacks and saves use that same source owner's currently lawful spell attack/PB, not a transferee's or a monster's sheet. Unless stated, saves add owner's PB, ordinary ability/skill checks add 0, normal vision only, no special damage or condition immunity, no independent equipment proficiency or spellcasting. One such spell-created asset per caster per spell ID; the existing total companion/control budget still binds. Creation grants no free attack or movement. A command uses one Bonus Action on the owner's regular turn through actual visible/audible communication within 60 ft; no telepathy is invented. It acts in the attached phase after that whole turn, shares the owner's one command and one offensive companion/device allowance per numbered round, and has no independent refresh on extra turns. Uncommanded it can only ordinary Dodge and make defensive movement within speed; no automatic pursuit, work or offense. Loss of the channel means no new command, not free autonomy. A complete task needs its real appendages, capacity, instructions and paid time. At 0 HP, expiry, source dismissal (Action) or concentration end where required, the asset ends; summoned apparatus disappears without loot, corpses, ammunition, harvest or salvage. An actual corpse used as fuel retains its original finite matter/history and the stated terminal consumption; no source can reclassify it as newly obtained material. Keep Ranger's genuinely ordinary animal remains distinct from no-resource summons.

sharedRules.title: Suppression and trigger ordering
sharedRules.wording: An ongoing magical object's target stays the same physical anchor; transfer or repair cannot duplicate/rearm it. Full magical suppression prevents sensing/operation while it lasts and does not queue missed triggers; duration continues. An acoustic silence can block only sound independently of a physically detected trigger. Resolve simultaneous eligible one-shot triggers in creation order then stable cast ID. Consume a triggered use before its payload, even when a later barrier, silence, immunity, cancellation or receiver state prevents useful output. A sound produced by another real spell can be a phonetic trigger if all actual constraints match, but each waiting trigger resolves at most once and cannot recreate itself or another charge. Source death/distance ends a nonconcentration effect only where the source/row says so; it does not refresh it. Suppression does not undo already completed mundane writing, moved matter, healing, damage or superficial preparation. An explicit persistent permanent spell remains a magical effect, not a manufactured item or free rechargeable device.

sharedRules.disposition: NEW spell-specific wrapper family; existing costs/cadence kept
sharedRules.title: Copying, acceleration, delay and proxies
sharedRules.wording: Cantrip Echo, Echo Cast, Quick Cast and Delay Spell are the only new wrapper identities authorized here. None may take itself or any of those four as payload, nor may an already echoed/released payload become a replay source. One payload may receive at most one of these temporal/replay modifications; they do not duplicate Ready or grant an additional Bonus Action, Reaction or full Action. Existing acquired class permissions remain their own exceptions, not automatically folded into this family. Select the actual original casting record, same ordinary source class and native legal access; only that spell's normal Action version with one finite resolution is eligible, excluding long casts, Reactions, Bonus Action spells and ongoing maintenance actions. Repeating a miss or resisted but fully resolved cast permits a fresh legal cast, not copying its damage result; a countered or aborted original is not a replay source. New targets/range/components and current costs/statistics must qualify at the new commitment. No active rider, successful roll, other caster's access, expended item charge or selected resource award is copied for free. Cantrip Echo's row defines one composite ordinary-cast transaction; Echo Cast/Quick Cast/Delay Spell instead have their separately paid arming transactions and later actual payload commitments. Record parent, wrapper, payload, cost, original owner and single-use consumption. No zero-base-cost replay recursively generates resource refunds or unearned casts. A legal fresh payload still resolves its own actual damage and expressly funded healing; this guard prevents copied old awards and recursive new-cast/refund grants, not the payload’s specified new outcome. Resonance Tether changes a legitimate delivery origin only, never the responsible caster or their RP/RC pool.

sharedRules.title: Reflection without a new cast
sharedRules.wording: Spell Mirror and Soul Mirror intercept only the first actually resolving ordinary spell effect that has exactly their warded creature as its sole direct creature recipient, beneficial or hostile. Area, multitarget, self-only, anchor/object, summoning, channel/ongoing tick and already redirected effects are ineligible. NEW interception/return distinction: a Touch-delivered, healing or willing-recipient spell is eligible for interception when it satisfies the foregoing sole-recipient and scope requirements. The original caster's eligibility to receive the return, including actual consent and creature-type requirements, is tested only after that eligible ward has been spent. An ineligible original caster therefore causes a spent, unsuccessful return and leaves the original recipient, exactly as below. A legal Touch return uses this explicit magical return, not a new physical touch or Action. No rank cap is added; actual protective exceptions can still forbid redirection. After counterspell resolution but before that spell's attack/save/effect, spend the ward once and substitute the original actual caster as recipient only when it is presently a legal recipient under the payload's own type/other eligibility. sharedRules.wording: The selected ordinary identity and its actual classAccess row control school, rank, minimum class level and base RP. Preserve the entire classAccess object, every catalog/Core original, book binding, placeholder, absent/null distinction and additionalRpCost. Enough RP does not grant access or repertoire. sharedRules.title: Actual casting transaction
sharedRules.wording: Use the selected source Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or longer casting time and actual V/S/F or M/F requirements. V requires the caster's own presently usable voice; recordings are not V. S and a real permitted focus obey the existing hand/access rules. Unpriced M/F permits the actual focus alternative and creates no invented costly/consumed material fee. Explicit physical substrates below are real target/work prerequisites, not inferred M costs. Observable legality is checked before commitment; hidden immunity/type/meaning does not become free diagnosis. At commitment spend the actual action/resources and update actual cast/cadence history before the existing counterspell chain; a countered, missed or resisted committed cast refunds nothing. Concentration begins under the existing rule and can end the old concentration even when the new cast is countered. Long casting uses actual uninterrupted work and governing interruption/Ready rules. No successful spell roll authenticates an asserted object, voice, teacher, corpse or world permission.

sharedRules.title: Native rolls and damage
sharedRules.wording: Spell attacks use the actual owner's spell attack modifier versus AC: natural 1 misses, natural 20 hits and doubles damage dice of that attack, not flat modifiers or later ticks. Saves are binary total-versus-spell-DC, with no natural-die degree shift. A specified examination is an INT (Investigation) task against the creating caster's snapshotted spell DC: use Core degrees/natural shifts, then collapse Success/Critical Success versus Failure/Critical Failure unless an entry supplies distinct outcomes. For one simultaneous area effect, snapshot geometry and eligible targets before damage, roll each stated shared damage expression once, then apply each recipient's save and actual type defenses independently. Half damage floors each typed component once at the stated save stage. Follow the existing reduction, immunity/resistance/vulnerability, temporary/form buffer, actual HP loss, Wound, death and concentration pipeline. No descriptive Damage/Healing/Control tag supplies an additional attack, damage, healing or condition.

sharedRules.disposition: KEEP; NEW explicit use where source timing is absent
sharedRules.title: Clocks
sharedRules.wording: A bare hostile one-round rider ends at the end of the target's next future regular turn, excluding an in-progress turn at application; a bare self/ally one-round benefit ends at the start of the caster's next future regular turn. N hostile rounds use the Nth such target end; N buff rounds use the Nth caster start. Outside initiative, those are 6N elapsed seconds. Keep the registered clock through initiative changes using the existing virtual-clock adapter; extra turns do not create expiry/tick opportunities. A NEW duration expressed in minutes/hours below uses an absolute elapsed deadline from completed resolution, including an absolute 60-second deadline for “1 minute”; the one-minute means neither an extra initial tick nor reset when initiative starts. Repeated round damage expressly uses future target regular-end checkpoints and its printed finite count, not one immediate tick plus that count. End-turn ticks/repeat saves precede their scheduled end-turn expiry; start expiry precedes voluntary actions. Suppression pauses eligibility/effect, not deadlines; scheduled suppressed ticks are spent, never queued. Entries that expressly use a named trigger instead of a generic clock keep that trigger.

sharedRules.title: Multiplicity, effect identity and present state
sharedRules.wording: Keep the existing strongest same-stat flat bonus, same-family cover arbitration, advantage/disadvantage cancellation and one eligible bonus-die spell per roll. Independent class exceptions retain their exact scopes; this is not a universal strongest-effect rule. NEW default for these previously uncompleted spells: one active instance per caster per ordinary spell ID, unless a row expressly permits more; a successfully resolved replacement ends that caster's prior instance, but an illegal/countered attempt does not replace a nonconcentration instance. Different casters retain separate source records, clocks and restrictions; identical numeric bonuses never add. A current complete record is required for every competing effect. Instantaneous completed consequences are not active-instance stock. An entry explicitly limiting waiting triggers counts only its stated waiting state; its spent playback phase never refills or occupies a waiting slot. Continual Flame explicitly permits separate paid anchors, with only its per-anchor limit; do not impose the default one-caster limit on it. Loss, repair, transfer, suppression or a new database ID cannot renew an already consumed mark, scheduled tick, trigger, command budget or source resource. Removal of one source does not erase another's independent condition. Any change in actual target/custody state is logged; it is not a new casting.

sharedRules.title: Attack/check marks
sharedRules.wording: A row expressly saying attack commitment reserves and spends its mark when the beneficiary commits a legal declared attack, before a roll; cancellation after that commitment and a miss do not refund it, while an illegal declaration that never commits does not spend it. Otherwise “next attack/check” marks spend on the next actual qualifying roll, including a miss/failure; unrelated rolls and passive procedures do not consume them. Mark recipients cannot choose to save a mark for a later preferred roll. A next-hit rider spends on the first qualifying hit, even if defenses reduce its damage to zero. Multiple competing next-roll marks eligible for the same event all spend, though only permitted strongest/advantage effects operate. Suppressed marks do not benefit or consume on an event while suppressed, but their deadline continues. Delivery attacks and later attacks consuming a delivered mark are different events.

sharedRules.title: Sight, illusions and meaning
sharedRules.wording: An image is not an opaque physical barrier, creature, material, light source, safe floor, sound receiver or extra targetable body unless its row expressly creates that thing. Ordinary hearing needs a real acoustic path; sight needs the relevant illumination, range and unobstructed view. Knowing an illusion does not grant sight through a real wall. For visual/audio deceptions below that permit examination, one Action using a currently accessible relevant sense can make the LR-G03 examination; success identifies that cast as illusory for that observer, while failure permits another examination only after genuinely new evidence or method. Conclusive witnessed physical contradiction establishes the applicable false part without a roll. An ally's warning allows examination but does not globally switch every observer to knowing. These procedures do not compel belief, pursuit, an attack, trust or a sale. Current Invisible rules remain: invisibility is not automatic Hidden; observers who know location lose only the special invisibility-derived attack advantage/disadvantage, not unrelated concealment. Language samples reproduce what was heard, not meaning or credentials. Preserve LA's six-second aggregate voluntary-speech budget per numbered round and actual component/oath windows. Spell-created sounds are not the caster's later speech, but original recording speech and the caster's V are real speech.

sharedRules.title: Range, targets and geometry
sharedRules.wording: Unless a specific row explicitly uses detection without sight, select an actually perceived eligible target or point within the literal Core range and with the existing line of effect. A target can be self within a creature-target range unless the source/row restricts it. “Willing” means current actual consent; an unwilling holder prevents a willing-only object spell without supplying an opposed-roll workaround. Detecting some magic is not necessarily perceiving a creature for targeting it. One target means one physical identity, not every same-named database row. NEW missing cone width is its length at its far end; missing line cross-section is five feet wide and five feet high. All source radii remain radii, not distances added to cast range. Area membership/cover are evaluated from the actual origin at that event; walls are not retroactively removed for a second pass. “Enemies” uses the caster's declared ordinary opposition set, not a supernatural alignment/intent detector. Caster/allies are included in indiscriminate areas. No range is silently replaced by an outside game's value.

sharedRules.title: Conditions and hard-control guard
sharedRules.wording: Use actual Blinded, Deafened, Frightened, Prone, Restrained, Incapacitated, Paralyzed and Stunned definitions without importing another game. Paralyzed/Incapacitated and other hard Action denial obey the current source-character/target/encounter allowance shared across that owner's effects; only successfully established hard control spends it, once for the effect's full allowed window. A blocked hard portion supplies no invented substitute penalty; independently printed damage, Prone or another separately allowed portion can remain. A spell's repeat save ends only the stated source. Ending laughter, restraint or paralysis does not automatically stand a Prone target. NEW “flee” directions below require actual safe available movement away at the next regular-turn movement opportunity, using existing Speed/cost and leaving Actions to the target; they do not force Dash, expend a Reaction or require deliberate self-harm. If no safe farther legal location exists, no movement is forced and no action is lost. Panicked is explicitly bound only in IL-23, not added as a global condition. Haste's voluntary ending cost is separately addressed in R3-12.

sharedRules.title: Movement, falls and body continuity
sharedRules.wording: Ordinary movement spends real movement cost and needs nonzero permitted Speed, legal support, actual space and the appropriate locomotion mode; changing a speed or mode does not reset spent cost. A spell-directed extra movement allowance expressly stated below supplies only that finite allowance. Teleportation relocates rather than traverses, does not itself provoke opportunity attacks and does not generically defeat a source that blocks relocation; no route is inferred through planes. Check destination occupancy, whole body/gear geometry and lawful carry/load. Supplying a point is not permission to materialize inside another body. Unsupported endings, launches and lost flight use the existing FallMarker and finite falling resolution, not a new immediate damage tick. Actual transformations retain original identity, own HP/resources, spent state, origin restrictions and body/equipment priority; no new monster sheet, harvest pool, HP refill, gear duplication or size-based ability increase. Actual equipment can be melded only by the stated form procedure, stays real weight/history and is unavailable while melded.

sharedRules.title: Summons, corpse assets and commands
sharedRules.wording: Each row supplies its actual finite body, attack and lifetime rather than importing a monster. Use printed HP/AC before any new fallback. For the NEW profiles below, creating caster's class level/PB/ability at creation fixes any printed-derived maximum; attacks and saves use that same source owner's currently lawful spell attack/PB, not a transferee's or a monster's sheet. Unless stated, saves add owner's PB, ordinary ability/skill checks add 0, normal vision only, no special damage or condition immunity, no independent equipment proficiency or spellcasting. One such spell-created asset per caster per spell ID; the existing total companion/control budget still binds. Creation grants no free attack or movement. A command uses one Bonus Action on the owner's regular turn through actual visible/audible communication within 60 ft; no telepathy is invented. It acts in the attached phase after that whole turn, shares the owner's one command and one offensive companion/device allowance per numbered round, and has no independent refresh on extra turns. Uncommanded it can only ordinary Dodge and make defensive movement within speed; no automatic pursuit, work or offense. Loss of the channel means no new command, not free autonomy. A complete task needs its real appendages, capacity, instructions and paid time. At 0 HP, expiry, source dismissal (Action) or concentration end where required, the asset ends; summoned apparatus disappears without loot, corpses, ammunition, harvest or salvage. An actual corpse used as fuel retains its original finite matter/history and the stated terminal consumption; no source can reclassify it as newly obtained material. Keep Ranger's genuinely ordinary animal remains distinct from no-resource summons.

sharedRules.title: Suppression and trigger ordering
sharedRules.wording: An ongoing magical object's target stays the same physical anchor; transfer or repair cannot duplicate/rearm it. Full magical suppression prevents sensing/operation while it lasts and does not queue missed triggers; duration continues. An acoustic silence can block only sound independently of a physically detected trigger. Resolve simultaneous eligible one-shot triggers in creation order then stable cast ID. Consume a triggered use before its payload, even when a later barrier, silence, immunity, cancellation or receiver state prevents useful output. A sound produced by another real spell can be a phonetic trigger if all actual constraints match, but each waiting trigger resolves at most once and cannot recreate itself or another charge. Source death/distance ends a nonconcentration effect only where the source/row says so; it does not refresh it. Suppression does not undo already completed mundane writing, moved matter, healing, damage or superficial preparation. An explicit persistent permanent spell remains a magical effect, not a manufactured item or free rechargeable device.

sharedRules.disposition: NEW spell-specific wrapper family; existing costs/cadence kept
sharedRules.title: Copying, acceleration, delay and proxies
sharedRules.wording: Cantrip Echo, Echo Cast, Quick Cast and Delay Spell are the only new wrapper identities authorized here. None may take itself or any of those four as payload, nor may an already echoed/released payload become a replay source. One payload may receive at most one of these temporal/replay modifications; they do not duplicate Ready or grant an additional Bonus Action, Reaction or full Action. Existing acquired class permissions remain their own exceptions, not automatically folded into this family. Select the actual original casting record, same ordinary source class and native legal access; only that spell's normal Action version with one finite resolution is eligible, excluding long casts, Reactions, Bonus Action spells and ongoing maintenance actions. Repeating a miss or resisted but fully resolved cast permits a fresh legal cast, not copying its damage result; a countered or aborted original is not a replay source. New targets/range/components and current costs/statistics must qualify at the new commitment. No active rider, successful roll, other caster's access, expended item charge or selected resource award is copied for free. Cantrip Echo's row defines one composite ordinary-cast transaction; Echo Cast/Quick Cast/Delay Spell instead have their separately paid arming transactions and later actual payload commitments. Record parent, wrapper, payload, cost, original owner and single-use consumption. No zero-base-cost replay recursively generates resource refunds or unearned casts. A legal fresh payload still resolves its own actual damage and expressly funded healing; this guard prevents copied old awards and recursive new-cast/refund grants, not the payload’s specified new outcome. Resonance Tether changes a legitimate delivery origin only, never the responsible caster or their RP/RC pool.

sharedRules.title: Reflection without a new cast
sharedRules.wording: Spell Mirror and Soul Mirror intercept only the first actually resolving ordinary spell effect that has exactly their warded creature as its sole direct creature recipient, beneficial or hostile. Area, multitarget, self-only, anchor/object, summoning, channel/ongoing tick and already redirected effects are ineligible. NEW interception/return distinction: a Touch-delivered, healing or willing-recipient spell is eligible for interception when it satisfies the foregoing sole-recipient and scope requirements. The original caster's eligibility to receive the return, including actual consent and creature-type requirements, is tested only after that eligible ward has been spent. An ineligible original caster therefore causes a spent, unsuccessful return and leaves the original recipient, exactly as below. A legal Touch return uses this explicit magical return, not a new physical touch or Action. No rank cap is added; actual protective exceptions can still forbid redirection. After counterspell resolution but before that spell's attack/save/effect, spend the ward once and substitute the original actual caster as recipient only when it is presently a legal recipient under the payload's own type/other eligibility. The original caster remains owner and supplies DC/attack roll and costs; this creates no new casting, resources or second packet. An ineligible original caster causes the spent redirection to fail and the original spell continues against its original warded target, not automatic cancellation. An eligible redirected attack can miss normally; spend is not refunded. The original targeting distance has already been established; the explicit return uses that same causal cast, with return line blocked by an actual barrier defeating the return path, not arbitrary remote range extension. A blocked return likewise leaves the original target. A causal root can be redirected at most once by these two spells; another mirror on the new target neither redirects it again nor consumes its ward. Duplicate wards on the original target arbitrate earliest creation then stable ID; only the selected ward spends. These are NEW finite interpretations of “first/single-target spell,” not permissions for Wizard/Oracle or other reflected-damage features to use this protocol.

sharedRules.title: Necrotic damage, healing, corpses and restrictions
sharedRules.wording: Actual damage and healing follow completed Core and feat procedures. No ordinary necrotic spell gains Bleeding, disease, Oracle Decay, a curse, corpse fuel, a soul resource or a healing prohibition by name/tag. A drain's specific permitted funding is stated in its row; an unfunded heal/RP transfer cannot be manufactured from overkill, a reflected packet, an already paid award, target transfer, current permission overriding no-resource origin, or a temporary body. Existing Lifedraw, Vampiric Touch, Lifeleech, Necrotic Affinity, Soul Cage feat and class drains keep their own nonidentical source predicates; the new drain restrictions are not retrospective amendments to them. Actual independently eligible acquired feats can respond once under their completed source rules, never a second time to the resulting heal/resource transfer. A corpse interface uses actual dead identity and retained memory; it does not establish an afterlife, soul custody, truth beyond memory or current thoughts. Preserve actual death/removal clocks, condition and no-resource restrictions through stabilization, question, animation and return. A later paid question cannot retrieve information the old remains never retained; fragments are one donor history, not separate minds.

sharedRules.disposition: KEEP; NEW bounded physical work choices
sharedRules.title: Real matter, preparations and economy
sharedRules.wording: A spell moving or reshaping real matter retains the actual predecessor quantity, material, contents, owner, damage and consumed/harvest history. Count retained mass and disposed matter once. It does not change source tier, named ingredient eligibility, equipment grade, formula knowledge, rarity, assigned value, an old recovery claim or an apparatus's paid service/charges. Cosmetic temperature/color/shape does not sterilize food, undo spoilage, neutralize a poison or supply a professional crafting result. Explicit elementary structures allowed below still need real support and dimensions; no unknown material or hidden load-bearing property is authenticated by the spell. A genuine subsequently usable mundane item can enter only its actual existing rules and finite market; no automatic sale price, buyer, XP or crafting-output multiplication. Fulfilled 687/433 recipe and NWX/LA procedures remain controlling.

sharedRules.title: Concentration and early termination
sharedRules.wording: Where a row says concentration, it occupies the one actual concentration slot, ends under the completed damage-save/incapacitation rules and can be ended voluntarily under that rule; no new per-round maintenance RP is imposed. A source explicitly printing concentration keeps it even when an independent rider ends sooner. NEW voluntary early termination for a nonconcentration instance authored below requires the original caster's Action and actual perception of its anchor/recipient within that spell's original range; no remote recall or refund. Instant completed consequences cannot be voluntarily reversed. Named permanent Until Dispelled effects have no general voluntary end from this default; use their own source or actual dispel. Invalid physical continued operation removes only what can no longer function; full destruction of a required anchor ends its anchored instance. No repaired anchor is a new instance.

sharedRules.title: Aliases and unassigned variants
sharedRules.wording: Uncontrollable Laughter uses the matching historical Tasha's Hideous Laughter Core metadata only through the explicit IL-18 binding; Resonance Tether analogously uses Mana Tether through UN-13. Preserve both historical names, exact effects and alias records without adding separate ordinary identities. Prestidigitation's two actual school modes are independently specified in IL-06 and selected by the cast's actual access row. Phantasmal Force rank 3, Stone Shape rank 4 and Mislead rank 5 remain preserved unassigned alternative records: no current classAccess row acquires those higher-rank modes, no chooser can buy them by paying more RP, and no new question or ordinary promotion is invented for them. The assigned lower-rank modes receive complete directions. Echo Cast's Core “base RP” is the chosen operational reading of its catalog's broader shorthand. Soul Tap's catalog HP AND Resonance selects the joint operation explicitly. Unravel Spell's “Tier 4” means the generating ordinary spell's rank≤4, not material/equipment/creature tier. All differences stay beside unchanged competing source fields.

sharedRules.title: Audience and comparison records
sharedRules.wording: All 137 selected ordinary identities and 141 original book bindings remain preserved internally; public teaching uses only actual public fields and the resulting operational mode when later exactly reviewed. A source mention does not publish a private dossier, class membership, material source or hidden research metadata. The 54 full selected class comparisons and 114 distinct spell counterparts retain their actual IDs, resource engines, windows and statuses; matching names/words do not merge any of them. Pending feats and spell comparisons stay pending. The eight submitted proposals are separately disposed below as source directions, not adopted by their mere inclusion. No change to the fulfilled language, teaching or recipe authority is required by these ordinary directions.

sharedRules.title: Delivery and deferred receipts
sharedRules.wording: R3-04 Blink is receipt-only: retain its full original and question, current pending operational state and literal setting references; author no plane itinerary, probability, reappearance/body procedure or promotion. Other incidental literal names, including Silent Ones, Heartcell, Matrix, Voice and deep-language terms when present, remain source receipts without interpretation. Local portals/teleports below are explicitly local procedures, not a decision about cosmology. Source authority here does not certify gameplay runtime, human teaching/balance, bestiary/acquisition availability, DD01 or final systemic consistency. Owner's final whole-game flow precedes an authorized GitHub push; verified remote commit precedes careful cosmology review. No deletion/push is authorized.

End-turn ticks/repeat saves precede their scheduled end-turn expiry; start expiry precedes voluntary actions. Suppression pauses eligibility/effect, not deadlines; scheduled suppressed ticks are spent, never queued. Entries that expressly use a named trigger instead of a generic clock keep that trigger.

sharedRules.title: Multiplicity, effect identity and present state
sharedRules.wording: Keep the existing strongest same-stat flat bonus, same-family cover arbitration, advantage/disadvantage cancellation and one eligible bonus-die spell per roll. Independent class exceptions retain their exact scopes; this is not a universal strongest-effect rule. NEW default for these previously uncompleted spells: one active instance per caster per ordinary spell ID, unless a row expressly permits more; a successfully resolved replacement ends that caster's prior instance, but an illegal/countered attempt does not replace a nonconcentration instance. Different casters retain separate source records, clocks and restrictions; identical numeric bonuses never add. A current complete record is required for every competing effect. Instantaneous completed consequences are not active-instance stock. An entry explicitly limiting waiting triggers counts only its stated waiting state; its spent playback phase never refills or occupies a waiting slot. Continual Flame explicitly permits separate paid anchors, with only its per-anchor limit; do not impose the default one-caster limit on it. Loss, repair, transfer, suppression or a new database ID cannot renew an already consumed mark, scheduled tick, trigger, command budget or source resource. Removal of one source does not erase another's independent condition. Any change in actual target/custody state is logged; it is not a new casting.

sharedRules.title: Attack/check marks
sharedRules.wording: A row expressly saying attack commitment reserves and spends its mark when the beneficiary commits a legal declared attack, before a roll; cancellation after that commitment and a miss do not refund it, while an illegal declaration that never commits does not spend it. Otherwise “next attack/check” marks spend on the next actual qualifying roll, including a miss/failure; unrelated rolls and passive procedures do not consume them. Mark recipients cannot choose to save a mark for a later preferred roll. A next-hit rider spends on the first qualifying hit, even if defenses reduce its damage to zero. Multiple competing next-roll marks eligible for the same event all spend, though only permitted strongest/advantage effects operate. Suppressed marks do not benefit or consume on an event while suppressed, but their deadline continues. Delivery attacks and later attacks consuming a delivered mark are different events.

sharedRules.title: Sight, illusions and meaning
sharedRules.wording: An image is not an opaque physical barrier, creature, material, light source, safe floor, sound receiver or extra targetable body unless its row expressly creates that thing. Ordinary hearing needs a real acoustic path; sight needs the relevant illumination, range and unobstructed view. Knowing an illusion does not grant sight through a real wall. For visual/audio deceptions below that permit examination, one Action using a currently accessible relevant sense can make the LR-G03 examination; success identifies that cast as illusory for that observer, while failure permits another examination only after genuinely new evidence or method. Conclusive witnessed physical contradiction establishes the applicable false part without a roll. An ally's warning allows examination but does not globally switch every observer to knowing. These procedures do not compel belief, pursuit, an attack, trust or a sale. Current Invisible rules remain: invisibility is not automatic Hidden; observers who know location lose only the special invisibility-derived attack advantage/disadvantage, not unrelated concealment. Language samples reproduce what was heard, not meaning or credentials. Preserve LA's six-second aggregate voluntary-speech budget per numbered round and actual component/oath windows. Spell-created sounds are not the caster's later speech, but original recording speech and the caster's V are real speech.

sharedRules.title: Range, targets and geometry
sharedRules.wording: Unless a specific row explicitly uses detection without sight, select an actually perceived eligible target or point within the literal Core range and with the existing line of effect. A target can be self within a creature-target range unless the source/row restricts it. “Willing” means current actual consent; an unwilling holder prevents a willing-only object spell without supplying an opposed-roll workaround. Detecting some magic is not necessarily perceiving a creature for targeting it. One target means one physical identity, not every same-named database row. NEW missing cone width is its length at its far end; missing line cross-section is five feet wide and five feet high. All source radii remain radii, not distances added to cast range. Area membership/cover are evaluated from the actual origin at that event; walls are not retroactively removed for a second pass. “Enemies” uses the caster's declared ordinary opposition set, not a supernatural alignment/intent detector. Caster/allies are included in indiscriminate areas. No range is silently replaced by an outside game's value.

sharedRules.title: Conditions and hard-control guard
sharedRules.wording: Use actual Blinded, Deafened, Frightened, Prone, Restrained, Incapacitated, Paralyzed and Stunned definitions without importing another game. Paralyzed/Incapacitated and other hard Action denial obey the current source-character/target/encounter allowance shared across that owner's effects; only successfully established hard control spends it, once for the effect's full allowed window. A blocked hard portion supplies no invented substitute penalty; independently printed damage, Prone or another separately allowed portion can remain. A spell's repeat save ends only the stated source. Ending laughter, restraint or paralysis does not automatically stand a Prone target. NEW “flee” directions below require actual safe available movement away at the next regular-turn movement opportunity, using existing Speed/cost and leaving Actions to the target; they do not force Dash, expend a Reaction or require deliberate self-harm. If no safe farther legal location exists, no movement is forced and no action is lost. Panicked is explicitly bound only in IL-23, not added as a global condition. Haste's voluntary ending cost is separately addressed in R3-12.

sharedRules.title: Movement, falls and body continuity
sharedRules.wording: Ordinary movement spends real movement cost and needs nonzero permitted Speed, legal support, actual space and the appropriate locomotion mode; changing a speed or mode does not reset spent cost. A spell-directed extra movement allowance expressly stated below supplies only that finite allowance. Teleportation relocates rather than traverses, does not itself provoke opportunity attacks and does not generically defeat a source that blocks relocation; no route is inferred through planes. Check destination occupancy, whole body/gear geometry and lawful carry/load. Supplying a point is not permission to materialize inside another body. Unsupported endings, launches and lost flight use the existing FallMarker and finite falling resolution, not a new immediate damage tick. Actual transformations retain original identity, own HP/resources, spent state, origin restrictions and body/equipment priority; no new monster sheet, harvest pool, HP refill, gear duplication or size-based ability increase. Actual equipment can be melded only by the stated form procedure, stays real weight/history and is unavailable while melded.

sharedRules.title: Summons, corpse assets and commands
sharedRules.wording: Each row supplies its actual finite body, attack and lifetime rather than importing a monster. Use printed HP/AC before any new fallback. For the NEW profiles below, creating caster's class level/PB/ability at creation fixes any printed-derived maximum; attacks and saves use that same source owner's currently lawful spell attack/PB, not a transferee's or a monster's sheet. Unless stated, saves add owner's PB, ordinary ability/skill checks add 0, normal vision only, no special damage or condition immunity, no independent equipment proficiency or spellcasting. One such spell-created asset per caster per spell ID; the existing total companion/control budget still binds. Creation grants no free attack or movement. A command uses one Bonus Action on the owner's regular turn through actual visible/audible communication within 60 ft; no telepathy is invented. It acts in the attached phase after that whole turn, shares the owner's one command and one offensive companion/device allowance per numbered round, and has no independent refresh on extra turns. Uncommanded it can only ordinary Dodge and make defensive movement within speed; no automatic pursuit, work or offense. Loss of the channel means no new command, not free autonomy. A complete task needs its real appendages, capacity, instructions and paid time. At 0 HP, expiry, source dismissal (Action) or concentration end where required, the asset ends; summoned apparatus disappears without loot, corpses, ammunition, harvest or salvage. An actual corpse used as fuel retains its original finite matter/history and the stated terminal consumption; no source can reclassify it as newly obtained material. Keep Ranger's genuinely ordinary animal remains distinct from no-resource summons.

sharedRules.title: Suppression and trigger ordering
sharedRules.wording: An ongoing magical object's target stays the same physical anchor; transfer or repair cannot duplicate/rearm it. Full magical suppression prevents sensing/operation while it lasts and does not queue missed triggers; duration continues. An acoustic silence can block only sound independently of a physically detected trigger. Resolve simultaneous eligible one-shot triggers in creation order then stable cast ID. Consume a triggered use before its payload, even when a later barrier, silence, immunity, cancellation or receiver state prevents useful output. A sound produced by another real spell can be a phonetic trigger if all actual constraints match, but each waiting trigger resolves at most once and cannot recreate itself or another charge. Source death/distance ends a nonconcentration effect only where the source/row says so; it does not refresh it. Suppression does not undo already completed mundane writing, moved matter, healing, damage or superficial preparation. An explicit persistent permanent spell remains a magical effect, not a manufactured item or free rechargeable device.

sharedRules.disposition: NEW spell-specific wrapper family; existing costs/cadence kept
sharedRules.title: Copying, acceleration, delay and proxies
sharedRules.wording: Cantrip Echo, Echo Cast, Quick Cast and Delay Spell are the only new wrapper identities authorized here. None may take itself or any of those four as payload, nor may an already echoed/released payload become a replay source. One payload may receive at most one of these temporal/replay modifications; they do not duplicate Ready or grant an additional Bonus Action, Reaction or full Action. Existing acquired class permissions remain their own exceptions, not automatically folded into this family. Select the actual original casting record, same ordinary source class and native legal access; only that spell's normal Action version with one finite resolution is eligible, excluding long casts, Reactions, Bonus Action spells and ongoing maintenance actions. Repeating a miss or resisted but fully resolved cast permits a fresh legal cast, not copying its damage result; a countered or aborted original is not a replay source. New targets/range/components and current costs/statistics must qualify at the new commitment. No active rider, successful roll, other caster's access, expended item charge or selected resource award is copied for free. Cantrip Echo's row defines one composite ordinary-cast transaction; Echo Cast/Quick Cast/Delay Spell instead have their separately paid arming transactions and later actual payload commitments. Record parent, wrapper, payload, cost, original owner and single-use consumption. No zero-base-cost replay recursively generates resource refunds or unearned casts. A legal fresh payload still resolves its own actual damage and expressly funded healing; this guard prevents copied old awards and recursive new-cast/refund grants, not the payload’s specified new outcome. Resonance Tether changes a legitimate delivery origin only, never the responsible caster or their RP/RC pool.

sharedRules.title: Reflection without a new cast
sharedRules.wording: Spell Mirror and Soul Mirror intercept only the first actually resolving ordinary spell effect that has exactly their warded creature as its sole direct creature recipient, beneficial or hostile. Area, multitarget, self-only, anchor/object, summoning, channel/ongoing tick and already redirected effects are ineligible. NEW interception/return distinction: a Touch-delivered, healing or willing-recipient spell is eligible for interception when it satisfies the foregoing sole-recipient and scope requirements. The original caster's eligibility to receive the return, including actual consent and creature-type requirements, is tested only after that eligible ward has been spent. An ineligible original caster therefore causes a spent, unsuccessful return and leaves the original recipient, exactly as below. A legal Touch return uses this explicit magical return, not a new physical touch or Action. No rank cap is added; actual protective exceptions can still forbid redirection. After counterspell resolution but before that spell's attack/save/effect, spend the ward once and substitute the original actual caster as recipient only when it is presently a legal recipient under the payload's own type/other eligibility. The original caster remains owner and supplies DC/attack roll and costs; this creates no new casting, resources or second packet. An ineligible original caster causes the spent redirection to fail and the original spell continues against its original warded target, not automatic cancellation. An eligible redirected attack can miss normally; spend is not refunded. The original targeting distance has already been established; the explicit return uses that same causal cast, with return line blocked by an actual barrier defeating the return path, not arbitrary remote range extension. A blocked return likewise leaves the original target. A causal root can be redirected at most once by these two spells; another mirror on the new target neither redirects it again nor consumes its ward. Duplicate wards on the original target arbitrate earliest creation then stable ID; only the selected ward spends. These are NEW finite interpretations of “first/single-target spell,” not permissions for Wizard/Oracle or other reflected-damage features to use this protocol.

sharedRules.title: Necrotic damage, healing, corpses and restrictions
sharedRules.wording: Actual damage and healing follow completed Core and feat procedures. No ordinary necrotic spell gains Bleeding, disease, Oracle Decay, a curse, corpse fuel, a soul resource or a healing prohibition by name/tag. A drain's specific permitted funding is stated in its row; an unfunded heal/RP transfer cannot be manufactured from overkill, a reflected packet, an already paid award, target transfer, current permission overriding no-resource origin, or a temporary body. Existing Lifedraw, Vampiric Touch, Lifeleech, Necrotic Affinity, Soul Cage feat and class drains keep their own nonidentical source predicates; the new drain restrictions are not retrospective amendments to them. Actual independently eligible acquired feats can respond once under their completed source rules, never a second time to the resulting heal/resource transfer. A corpse interface uses actual dead identity and retained memory; it does not establish an afterlife, soul custody, truth beyond memory or current thoughts. Preserve actual death/removal clocks, condition and no-resource restrictions through stabilization, question, animation and return. A later paid question cannot retrieve information the old remains never retained; fragments are one donor history, not separate minds.

sharedRules.disposition: KEEP; NEW bounded physical work choices
sharedRules.title: Real matter, preparations and economy
sharedRules.wording: A spell moving or reshaping real matter retains the actual predecessor quantity, material, contents, owner, damage and consumed/harvest history. Count retained mass and disposed matter once. It does not change source tier, named ingredient eligibility, equipment grade, formula knowledge, rarity, assigned value, an old recovery claim or an apparatus's paid service/charges. Cosmetic temperature/color/shape does not sterilize food, undo spoilage, neutralize a poison or supply a professional crafting result. Explicit elementary structures allowed below still need real support and dimensions; no unknown material or hidden load-bearing property is authenticated by the spell. A genuine subsequently usable mundane item can enter only its actual existing rules and finite market; no automatic sale price, buyer, XP or crafting-output multiplication. Fulfilled 687/433 recipe and NWX/LA procedures remain controlling.

sharedRules.title: Concentration and early termination
sharedRules.wording: Where a row says concentration, it occupies the one actual concentration slot, ends under the completed damage-save/incapacitation rules and can be ended voluntarily under that rule; no new per-round maintenance RP is imposed. A source explicitly printing concentration keeps it even when an independent rider ends sooner. NEW voluntary early termination for a nonconcentration instance authored below requires the original caster's Action and actual perception of its anchor/recipient within that spell's original range; no remote recall or refund. Instant completed consequences cannot be voluntarily reversed. Named permanent Until Dispelled effects have no general voluntary end from this default; use their own source or actual dispel. Invalid physical continued operation removes only what can no longer function; full destruction of a required anchor ends its anchored instance. No repaired anchor is a new instance.

sharedRules.title: Aliases and unassigned variants
sharedRules.wording: Uncontrollable Laughter uses the matching historical Tasha's Hideous Laughter Core metadata only through the explicit IL-18 binding; Resonance Tether analogously uses Mana Tether through UN-13. Preserve both historical names, exact effects and alias records without adding separate ordinary identities. Prestidigitation's two actual school modes are independently specified in IL-06 and selected by the cast's actual access row. Phantasmal Force rank 3, Stone Shape rank 4 and Mislead rank 5 remain preserved unassigned alternative records: no current classAccess row acquires those higher-rank modes, no chooser can buy them by paying more RP, and no new question or ordinary promotion is invented for them. The assigned lower-rank modes receive complete directions. Echo Cast's Core “base RP” is the chosen operational reading of its catalog's broader shorthand. Soul Tap's catalog HP AND Resonance selects the joint operation explicitly. Unravel Spell's “Tier 4” means the generating ordinary spell's rank≤4, not material/equipment/creature tier. All differences stay beside unchanged competing source fields.

sharedRules.title: Audience and comparison records
sharedRules.wording: All 137 selected ordinary identities and 141 original book bindings remain preserved internally; public teaching uses only actual public fields and the resulting operational mode when later exactly reviewed. A source mention does not publish a private dossier, class membership, material source or hidden research metadata. The 54 full selected class comparisons and 114 distinct spell counterparts retain their actual IDs, resource engines, windows and statuses; matching names/words do not merge any of them. Pending feats and spell comparisons stay pending. The eight submitted proposals are separately disposed below as source directions, not adopted by their mere inclusion. No change to the fulfilled language, teaching or recipe authority is required by these ordinary directions.

sharedRules.title: Delivery and deferred receipts
sharedRules.wording: R3-04 Blink is receipt-only: retain its full original and question, current pending operational state and literal setting references; author no plane itinerary, probability, reappearance/body procedure or promotion. Other incidental literal names, including Silent Ones, Heartcell, Matrix, Voice and deep-language terms when present, remain source receipts without interpretation. Local portals/teleports below are explicitly local procedures, not a decision about cosmology. Source authority here does not certify gameplay runtime, human teaching/balance, bestiary/acquisition availability, DD01 or final systemic consistency. Owner's final whole-game flow precedes an authorized GitHub push; verified remote commit precedes careful cosmology review. No deletion/push is authorized.

# Deep Dwarf Kavalrachni

**Family:** Deep Folk
**Knowledge status:** Established Field Record
**Publication classification:** Public
**Dungeon range:** T1, Floors 1-10
**Primary source:** Haven treaty archives, captured correspondence, and parley reports
**Reliability:** High
**Encounter role:** Skirmisher or social adversary

## What It Is

Deep Dwarf Kavalrachni is an intelligent floor-dweller with territorial, religious, or political motives. Directors should establish what it protects before combat, because defeating it may create a worse enemy or close a valuable route.

## What Experienced Expeditions Notice

Masonry repaired from the inside; water channels marked with votive cuts; discarded fungi sorted by toxicity; warning bolts deliberately embedded at eye level.

## Creature Knowledge

Use **History or Insight** unless the Director approves a more specific approach.

| Result | Information Learned |
|---|---|
| DC 11 | Creature family, usual habitat, and dominant attack type. |
| DC 15 | The first reliable counter and the sign that its strongest ability is ready. |
| DC 19 | Its defining tactical weakness, safe harvest method, and likely retreat condition. |

## Knowledge Status and Reliability

**Status:** Established Field Record  
**Primary source:** Haven treaty archives, captured correspondence, and parley reports  
**Reliability:** High  
**Last confirmed:** Current Opening and prior guild registries  
**Confirmed range:** Floors 1-10  
**Rumored range:** Regional variants may extend beyond the confirmed range

## Stat Block

**Medium Humanoid, Lawful Neutral**  
**Challenge** 3 (700 XP budget) · **Dungeon Range** T1 · **Floors** 1-10
**Armor** 14 · **Hit Points** 88 · **Speed** 40 ft.

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 12 (+1) | 14 (+2) | 14 (+2) | 12 (+1) | 12 (+1) | 11 (+0) |

**Resistances** None  
**Immunities** None  
**Condition Immunities** None  
**Tactical Vulnerability** None identified  
**Save DC** 11  

### Traits

**Prepared Ground.** It gains advantage on the first attack or check made from a fortified position in its lair.

### Actions

**Precise Cut.** *Attack:* +5 to hit, one target. *Hit:* 2d6+2 slashing damage (average 9).

## How It Fights

It opens with **Precise Cut** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. It uses prepared cover and retreats behind the next defensive layer when the first is lost.

## How to Defeat It

**Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for slashing damage.
- Map doors, bridges, and firing lanes before parley fails.

**Combat Priority**

Deny prepared terrain and command figures; accept surrender when the objective is secured.

**Exploit**

The defining weakness is **None identified**. Treat this as an encounter solution rather than an automatic damage vulnerability. Successful Research, Recon, or Resource actions should make the exploit easier or safer.

**Withdraw When**

Withdraw or change the objective when the creature reaches favorable terrain or isolates a target. A failed retreat against this creature usually costs more than abandoning the immediate treasure.

## Habitat, Goals, and Lair

Defended holds use layered doors, murder shafts, water traps, narrow bridges, and negotiated kill zones. Religious sites add chanting pools, toxin vents, and captive witnesses.

The deep folk are not one faction. They are cultures forced into the same trade roads, flooded caverns, and defensive wars. Their encounters should begin with motive before initiative.

Deep folk respond to ownership, passage rights, debts, clan names, and proof of common enemies.

## Treasure and Harvest

**Harvest skill:** Medicine · **Harvest DC:** 11 · **Base time:** 30 minutes  
**Restriction:** Routine harvesting is culturally prohibited or legally restricted; samples require consent, lawful authority, or explicit dark-path play.  

| Component | Tier | Drop / Value |
|---|---:|---|
| Monstrous Claw (Tier 1) | 1 | 59%, 13 gp base |
| Exotic Hide (Tier 2) | 2 | 49%, 26 gp base |

Humanoid harvesting is restricted. Salvage weapons, armor, mounts’ shed chitin, venom, ritual reagents, and legally claimed battlefield equipment instead.

## Variants and Encounter Use

Change faction, passage rights, fortifications, and surrender terms. Intelligent foes should not be reskinned as mindless monsters.

## What It Is

Poison-Skin is part of Bloomdeep’s economy of rot, medicine, hunger, and propagation. Its body and lair exchange material constantly, so killing the visible creature does not always end the encounter.

## What Experienced Expeditions Notice

Bubbles moving against the current; mushrooms opening toward wounded creatures; bones polished clean without tooth marks; bright amphibian prints ending beneath stagnant water.

**Resistances** None  
**Immunities** None  
**Condition Immunities** None  
**Tactical Vulnerability** airflow control and source-node destruction  
**Save DC** 11  

### Traits

**Living Substrate.** It can use roots, spores, corpses, or standing water in its lair as the origin point of one action.

### Actions

**Heavy Blow.** *Attack:* +5 to hit, one target. *Hit:* 2d6+2 bludgeoning damage (average 9).

## How It Fights

It opens with **Heavy Blow** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. It turns corpses, spilled reagents, open wounds, and standing water into additional pressure.

## How to Defeat It

**Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for bludgeoning damage.
- Seal skin and breathing; separate fire from concentrated spores.

**Combat Priority**

Remove brood pools, root nodes, corpses, or chemical trails that sustain the creature.

**Exploit**

The defining weakness is **airflow control and source-node destruction**. Treat this as an encounter solution rather than an automatic damage vulnerability. Successful Research, Recon, or Resource actions should make the exploit easier or safer.

**Withdraw When**

Withdraw or change the objective when the creature reaches favorable terrain or isolates a target. A failed retreat against this creature usually costs more than abandoning the immediate treasure.

## Habitat, Goals, and Lair

Marsh lairs use water depth, root tunnels, spore pockets, floating ground, and corrosive pools. Fire solves some problems but can turn enclosed spores into explosions.

Bloomdeep turns hunger, rot, medicine, and reproduction into the same ecological process. Its creatures are dangerous because every wound, corpse, and abandoned ration can become part of the next encounter.

Sporefolk and Poison-Skins can negotiate. Grazers and crawlers are driven by chemical cues; changing scent may redirect them.

**Harvest skill:** Medicine · **Harvest DC:** 11 · **Base time:** 1 hour  
**Restriction:** Routine harvesting is culturally prohibited or legally restricted; samples require consent, lawful authority, or explicit dark-path play.

Venom, spores, glands, slime, hide, root fiber, and digestive acid are useful but spoil quickly and require separated containers.

## Variants and Encounter Use

Change substrate, spore, toxin, or brood source. A clean battlefield makes these creatures weaker; an abandoned battlefield makes them stronger.

originalExamples.originalText: A warded ally receives 11 fire damage from a spell. Resistance leaves 5 before a legal Warding Bond split; the transferred share receives no second resistance.
An ordinary sword attack under a spell buff remains a weapon attack. This ward alone does not halve its ordinary physical damage.
A rank-3 spell with one hostile creature target can return to its caster if the return target and path are legal. A rank-4 spell remains ineligible even when discounted to 3 RP.
Two protected creatures cannot bounce one spell indefinitely: the first redirected packet is already reflected and cannot trigger another shield.
Both teleport endpoints outside the sphere permit transit even if a straight line between them crosses the sphere.
A portal can remain visible while its endpoint is blocked. A transit defeated after commitment leaves the traveler and real gear at the origin, with costs spent.
A Corrupted creature fails its CON save on its first crossing attempt: it takes the rolled 2d6 and stops before the wall. Success halves damage but still blocks crossing.
A creature without actual Corrupted eligibility can cross. A fitting teleport destination beyond the wall also avoids contact; neither grants hidden moral or origin information.
A 0-RP cantrip inside costs 2 RP; an applicable final Ease adjustment of −1 makes 1 RP. A caster without an RP pool cannot commit it.
Two overlapping fields still add only 2 RP. Releasing a spell already prepared with Ready does not pay again.
Protection overlaps a +1 AC ward. A qualifying member receives +2, rather than +3.
Favorable standing does not establish membership and supplies no sanctuary bonus by itself.
A locked axis stays at its recorded effective value while an independent underlying change is retained. Expiry exposes that current underlying record.
An undefined axis is not assigned Neutral. An observer does not automatically learn a hidden locked value.
The Cleric placement remains rank 7 and base 17 RP. A Druid’s rank-4 zone does not lower that price or grant its own seven-day single-target mode.
A Director cannot invent a moral requirement forcing a player to attack an ally. No established incompatibility predicate means no conduct veto.
A commanded 2d6 heal can restore a living ally at 0 HP if no actual restriction blocks healing. It spends the round’s shared companion activation.
The pet has no swim mode simply because it looks like water. Its disappearance produces no harvestable water.
Hits dealing 23 and 17 damage to different sections deplete the same 40-HP pool and remove the entire wall.
Sight range permits a distant visible legal segment. It does not reveal placement behind existing total cover.
On a failed save, a surviving target with 3 RP loses 3 and reaches 0. The caster gains 0 RP.
If fire damage is prevented by immunity but the CON save failed, a living target’s actual RP pool still loses up to 5.

An actual Elemental fails WIS while the source’s shared guard is unused. Paralyzed spends that guard and may end at the first repeat save; persistence through a second turn does not spend another mark.
A humanoid casting elemental spells is not an Elemental. A real Elemental already hard-controlled by this source character receives no invented fallback from a later failed save.
You can return with your real backpack to a personally examined balcony 450 feet away if its arrival space is still legal.
If that space is secretly occupied, the paid spell fails at the origin. It gives neither an adjacent substitute nor a duplicated backpack.
An enrolled ally spends an Action and 2 RP to arrive in the free square. A second ally must wait until that square is clear.
Lifting the marked paving stone ends the fixed beacon. It cannot become a free movable destination.
The Envoy’s two attack components use one commanded offensive Action, leaving no shared offensive allowance for another companion that round.
Favorable reputation alone does not authorize this cast without actual faction membership and invocation permission.
